excludedContent.reason: Package/build/map linkage identifies emitted release/vendor assets. Retain selected integration and bounded meaningful app functions; exclude dependency/scaffold/CSS/map churn by provenance, never size.
excludedContent.scope: These flags apply to the excluded broad payload/diff, not the explicitly retained application snapshots at the same files. Incidental encoded-footer exposure is truthfully recorded in the separate private incident.

source.inspectionScope: Exact selected integration diff and explicit bounded emitted application functions; generated payload scope is separately classified. No whole generated diff, Suite, runtime, compiler equivalence or upstream build-result claim.
